evals.prompt: 我想练习面试，这是我的简历：张三，5年C++开发经验，目前在国内一家GPU公司做编译器工具链开发，主要负责调试器和Sanitizer工具的开发维护。硕士学历。请帮我模拟面试。
evals.expected_output: Skill should start the pre-interview pipeline: acknowledge resume, ask for additional materials, generate a virtual company profile, negotiate JD, then begin interview rounds.
expectations: The agent acknowledges the resume and extracts key info (C++, compiler toolchain, GPU, 5 years, master's degree)
The agent asks whether additional materials (code, blog, docs) are available
The agent generates a virtual company profile with all required dimensions (name, industry, employee count, revenue, stage, business lines, culture, founder)
The agent presents the company profile to the user
The agent asks what position the candidate wants to interview for
The agent generates a JD and discusses it with the user until satisfied
The agent confirms company background and final JD before starting the interview
The agent selects an interviewer persona for Round 1 without revealing it
The interview is conducted in Chinese (matching the resume language)

evals.prompt: I want to practice interviewing. Here is my resume: John Smith, 8 years of experience in distributed systems and cloud infrastructure, currently a senior engineer at a tech company. Bachelor's degree in CS. Please run a mock interview for me.
evals.expected_output: Skill should run the pre-interview pipeline in English, generate a company profile matching a senior cloud/distributed systems engineer, negotiate a JD, and begin the technical interview round.
expectations: The agent acknowledges the resume and extracts key info (distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, 8 years, senior engineer, bachelor's degree)
The agent generates a virtual company profile with all required dimensions
The company profile matches the candidate's level (senior, 8 years → mid-to-large company)
The JD negotiation is conducted in English (matching the resume language)
When the technical interview begins, questions are relevant to distributed systems and cloud infrastructure
The agent does not reveal the interviewer persona during the interview
Technical Q&A follows the probing rhythm: conceptual → implementation → edge cases/tradeoffs
The agent respects the probing limit of 3-4 follow-up rounds per question
If blind coding is reached, the problem type matches an infrastructure/cloud role (not a pure algorithm puzzle)

evals.prompt: 模拟面试，简历：李四，3年Java开发，某互联网公司后端开发。请帮我模拟面试。在面试过程中，如果进入第三轮，请观察面试官是否遵守不涉及个人隐私的约束。
evals.expected_output: Skill should run through the full interview pipeline. In the leadership round, the stress test must not involve personal privacy (family, health, financial details).
expectations: The agent acknowledges the resume and starts the pre-interview pipeline
The agent generates a virtual company profile with all required dimensions
The agent conducts JD negotiation before starting interviews
Each round is executed by a subagent (or the agent simulates subagent behavior with persona adoption)
After each round, the agent asks whether to continue or end
If Round 3 is reached, stress test questions challenge viewpoints and logic without involving personal privacy
The agent does not ask about family situation, health conditions, or specific financial details
Stage documents are output after each round with the correct naming format (interview-round{N}-YYYY-MM-DD.md)
A final report is generated with the correct naming format (interview-report-YYYY-MM-DD.md)
The final report includes interviewer personas revealed after the interview
The final report evaluates from a third-party objective perspective, not from the company's standpoint
